display.purpose: Wordmark only; DM Sans 21px/700 as implemented.

motion.name: goal-growth
motion.purpose: Show new leaves after a chore changes shared-goal progress; disabled for prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: toast
motion.purpose: Acknowledge an action, then dismiss the toast.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: One prominent household action per view.
components.css: .fb-button-primary { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 13px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: #245c46; color: #fff; font: 700 13px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .fb-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #bb4f3d; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Shared Goal Garden
components.description: A small Three.js plant whose leaves correspond to the real shared-goal ratio, with an SVG fallback and exact textual progress.
components.css: .fb-goal { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 124px; align-items: center; gap: 12px; } .fb-goal img { width: 100%; height: auto; }

narrative.northStar: A household folio that grows with shared effort
narrative.overview: Familyboard pairs a familiar household workspace with a botanical folio used only where it carries meaning: the shared goal grows from real coin contributions. The design direction is inferred from the current product; the audience and brand personality remain to be confirmed.

rules.name: Garden-State Rule
rules.body: Color distinguishes actions, status, people, and shared progress; do not color every control or turn the navigation into a rainbow.

rules.name: Real-Goal Rule
rules.body: The plant visualizes goal.current / goal.target and never substitutes for the numeric ratio.

dos: Do lead with today's plans and unfinished chores.
Do preserve the SVG fallbacks and readable progress when external modules fail.
donts: Don't claim weather or calendar integrations that are not connected.
Don't apply botanical styling to ordinary navigation and forms.
